background: Barclays Bank PLC is the non-ring-fenced bank of Barclays, housing the corporate and investment bank, the international cards business and the private bank, funded by corporate deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: Ratings match the ring-fenced bank at A+ on average across all three main agencies, all three on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratios are thinner: CET1 of 12.6% is in the bottom quarter of UK majors against the peer median, while leverage of 5.5% is in the top quarter. Liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 140% below the peer median and NSFR of 112% in the bottom quarter. LCR has fallen 14 points since 30 Jun 2025, the rest has been flat. The newest flagged item, on 10 Sep 2026, is repeated outages on its trading risk platform; the earlier news was profit up strongly on trading revenue, a reminder that earnings here are market-driven.
